caption:
The waiting is starting to feel like being forgotten. But what if this silence isn't God's absence — it's exactly where the real thing is being grown? (Galatians 4:26-28 devotional)

A wish leans on how badly you want it, so when the waiting drags, wanting alone runs dry. But you're a child of promise like Isaac, and real hope is anchored in the One who spoke, not in the length of the wait — like a seed buried in the dark, you're not lost, you're being grown. The silence isn't neglect; it's where He teaches you to lean on Him alone.
